item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: this was pretty good, but we already have something similar. SCP-3000-EX is also about how even if it's not anomalous it can still be fucked up. the gore didn't really do it for me either, I'll still give it a +1 though because I like 028.

item.title: Re: Author's Note
item.content:encoded: Nope. Actually, never heard of 1810. I based the character on John Wayne Gacy, but added my own twisted spin on it.

item.title: Re: Author's Note
item.content:encoded:
I liked it but I kinda feel like you missed the opportunity with the children's identity staying unknown in the end. All in all, it's a +1 for me.

If I can guess right the tall man is SCP-1810, right?

item.title: Author's Note
item.content:encoded:
So, if you managed to read the whole thing, congrats. I'm still having nightmares from writing it. Hopefully this tale isn't that horrible.

Huge thank you to TheMightyMcB and DrAkimoto.

EXTRA SPECIAL THANKS to Mew-ltiverse for helping me with my research. It may not be perfect, but I hope that it is at least accurate.

And remember, if you dislike this tale, please tell me why in the discussion. I would appreciate any feedback. :)
